AMD-97467.title: AI Framework Eng.(VLLM CI)
AMD-97467.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.
At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.
Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.
THE ROLE:
As a senior member of the LLM inference framework team, you will be responsible for building and optimizing production-grade single-node and distributed inference runtimes for large language models on AMD GPUs.
You will work at the framework and runtime layer, driving performance, scalability, and reliability, enabling tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, expert parallelism (
MoE
), and single-node or multi-node inference at scale.
Your work will directly power customer-facing deployments and benchmarking platforms (e.g.,
InferenceMax
,
MLPerf
, strategic partners, and cloud providers) and will be
upstreamed
into open-source inference frameworks such as
vLLM
and
SGLang
to make AMD a first-class platform for LLM serving.
This role sits at the intersection of inference engines, distributed systems, and GPU runtime and kernel backends.
THE PERSON
:
You are a systems-minded ML engineer who thinks in terms of throughput, latency, memory movement, and scheduling, not just model code.
You are comfortable reading and modifying large-scale inference frameworks, debugging performance across GPUs and nodes, and collaborating with kernel, compiler, and networking teams to close end-to-end performance gaps.
You enjoy working in open source and driving architecture-level improvements in inference platforms.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Inference Framework & Runtime
Architect and optimize distributed LLM inference runtimes based on in-house LLM engines or open-source stacks such as
vLLM
,
SGLang
, and
llm
-d
Design and improve TP / PP / EP (
MoE
) hybrid execution, including KV-cache management, attention dispatch, and token scheduling
Implement and optimize multi-node inference pipelines using RCCL, RDMA, and collective-based execution
Performance & Scalability
Drive throughput, latency, and memory efficiency across single-GPU and multi-GPU clusters
Optimize continuous batching, speculative decoding, KV-cache paging, prefix caching, and multi-turn serving
GPU & Backend Integration
Work with AMD GPU libraries (AITER, HIPBLAS-LT, RCCL,
ROCm
runtime) to ensure inference frameworks efficiently use FP8 / FP4 GEMM and
FlashAttention
/ MLA
Collaborate with compiler teams (Triton, LLVM,
ROCm
) to unblock framework-level performance
Open Source & Customer Enablement
Upstream features and performance fixes into
vLLM
,
SGLang
, and
llm
-d
Enable customer
PoCs
and production deployments on AMD platforms
Build and maintain benchmark-grade inference pipelines
AMD-97467.requirements:
Inference Stack Knowledge
Hands-on understanding of
vLLM
,
SGLang
, or similar inference stacks
Experience with distributed inference scaling and a proven track record of contributing to upstream open-source projects
Deep Learning Integration
Strong experience integrating optimized GPU performance into machine-learning frameworks (e.g.,
PyTorch
, TensorFlow) for high-throughput and scalable inference
Kernel & Inference Frameworks
Strong background in NVIDIA, AMD, or similar GPU architectures and kernel development
Software Engineering
Expertise in Python and preferably experience in C/C++, including debugging, performance tuning, and test design for large-scale systems
High-Performance Computing
Experience running large-scale workloads on heterogeneous GPU clusters, optimizing for efficiency and scalability
Compiler & Runtime Optimization
Understanding of compiler and runtime systems, including LLVM,
ROCm
, and GPU code generation
ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:
Master’s or PhD
in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or
a related field
.

AMD-89499.title: AI Framework Engineer
AMD-89499.description:
WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING
At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs,
gaming
and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human
ingenuity
and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD,
you’ll
discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond.
Together, we advance your career.
THE ROLE:
As a core member of the team, you will play a pivotal role in
optimizing
and developing deep learning frameworks for AMD GPUs. Your experience will be critical in enhancing GPU kernels, deep learning models, and training/inference performance across multi-GPU and multi-node systems. You will engage with both internal GPU library teams and open-source maintainers to ensure seamless integration of optimizations,
utilizing
cutting-edge
compiler technologies and advanced engineering principles to drive continuous improvement.
THE PERSON:
Skilled
engineer with strong technical and analytical
expertise
in C++ development within Linux environments. The ideal candidate will thrive in both collaborative team settings and independent work, with the ability to define goals, manage development efforts, and deliver high-quality solutions. Strong problem-solving skills, a proactive approach, and a keen understanding of software engineering best practices are essential.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Deep Learning & LLM Framework Optimization:
Optimize major DL/LLM frameworks (TensorFlow,
PyTorch
,
vLLM
,
SGLang
) for AMD GPUs and contribute improvements upstream.
GPU Kernel & Operator Optimization:
Develop and tune GPU kernels and performance-critical operators to maximize throughput and minimize latency.
Model & Architecture Optimization:
Adapt and optimize LLM architectures (e.g., Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek) and apply advanced techniques like
FlashAttention
,
PagedAttention
, and quantization.
End-to-End Performance Engineering:
Perform comprehensive profiling to identify bottlenecks and implement system, memory, and communication optimizations across multi-GPU and multi-node setups.
Compiler & Pipeline Acceleration:
Leverage advanced compiler technologies and graph compilers to enhance the full deep learning and inference pipeline.
Research & Advanced Techniques:
Prototype and integrate emerging optimization methods such as speculative decoding and weight-only quantization into production systems.
Cross-Team & Open-Source Collaboration:
Collaborate with internal GPU library teams and open-source maintainers to align improvements and ensure seamless upstream integration.
Software Engineering Excellence:
Apply robust engineering practices to deliver maintainable, reliable, and production-quality performance optimizations.
AMD-89499.requirements:
Inference Frameworks, Model Architectures & Optimization Expertise:
Strong practical experience with
vLLM
or
SGLang
, mastery of modern LLMs (e.g., DeepSeek, Qwen), strong theoretical grounding in Transformer/Attention/
MoE
/KV Cache, and hands-on application of advanced inference optimizations such as
FlashAttention
,
PagedAttention
, continuous batching, and quantization (INT8/INT4/GPTQ/AWQ).
End-to-End LLM Performance Engineering:
Demonstrated ability to profile, diagnose, and optimize
compute
, memory, and communication bottlenecks across multi-GPU and multi-node environments.
High-Performance Computing:
Expert e
xperience running and optimizing large-scale workloads on heterogeneous clusters with a focus on efficiency, reliability, and scalability.
Deep Learning Framework Integration:
Proven ability to integrate optimized GPU kernels into TensorFlow/
PyTorch
to accelerate large-scale training and inference with strong scaling and throughput.
Software Engineering Excellence & Community Contribution:
Expert in Python/C++ coding skills, effective debugging and testing practices, proven ability to deliver maintainable performance-critical software, and a track record of open-source contributions with strong self-motivation.
GPU Kernel Development & Optimization is a plus:
Hands-on solid experience designing and tuning high-performance GPU kernels for AMD GPUs using HIP, CUDA, ASM, and tools like CK, CUTLASS, and Triton, with
strong
knowledge of GCN/RDNA architectures.
Compiler & System-Level Optimization is a plus:
Expert foundational knowledge of LLVM,
ROCm
, and compiler-driven techniques for improving kernel and system performance.
ACADEMIC & PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor’s and/or
Master’s
Degree
in Computer Science
, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or
a related field
.
Low-Level Development Skills:
Experience with
CUDA
C++ programming for writing and debugging high-performance GPU kernels; or practical experience using
Triton
to develop and optimize deep learning operators.
Compiler Knowledge:
Understanding or practical experience with compiler technologies like TVM or MLIR is a significant advantage.
Distributed Systems Experience:
Hands-on experience with distributed inference for large-scale models (e.g., Tensor Parallel, Pipeline Parallel).

As a senior member of the LLM inference framework team, you will be responsible for building and optimizing production-grade single-node and distributed inference runtimes for large language models on AMD GPUs.
You will work at the framework and runtime layer, driving performance, scalability, and reliability, enabling tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, expert parallelism (
MoE
), and single-node or multi-node inference at scale.

,
MLPerf

SGLang

THE PERSON
:
You are a systems-minded ML engineer who thinks in terms of throughput, latency, memory movement, and scheduling, not just model code.
You are comfortable reading and modifying large-scale inference frameworks, debugging performance across GPUs and nodes, and collaborating with kernel, compiler, and networking teams to close end-to-end performance gaps.
You enjoy working in open source and driving architecture-level improvements in inference platforms.

Performance & Scalability
Drive throughput, latency, and memory efficiency across single-GPU and multi-GPU clusters
Optimize continuous batching, speculative decoding, KV-cache paging, prefix caching, and multi-turn serving

Work with AMD GPU libraries (AITER, HIPBLAS-LT, RCCL,
ROCm
runtime) to ensure inference frameworks efficiently use FP8 / FP4 GEMM and
FlashAttention
/ MLA
Collaborate with compiler teams (Triton, LLVM,
ROCm
) to unblock framework-level performance
Open Source & Customer Enablement
Upstream features and performance fixes into
vLLM
,

, and
llm
-d

PoCs
and production deployments on AMD platforms
Build and maintain benchmark-grade inference pipelines

AMD-96119.description:

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

THE ROLE:
As a senior member of the LLM inference framework team, you will be responsible for building and optimizing production-grade single-node and distributed inference runtimes for large language models on AMD GPUs.
You will work at the framework and runtime layer, driving performance, scalability, and reliability, enabling tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, expert parallelism (
MoE
), and single-node or multi-node inference at scale.
Your work will directly power customer-facing deployments and benchmarking platforms (e.g.,
InferenceMax
,
MLPerf
, strategic partners, and cloud providers) and will be
upstreamed
into open-source inference frameworks such as
vLLM
and
SGLang
to make AMD a first-class platform for LLM serving.
This role sits at the intersection of inference engines, distributed systems, and GPU runtime and kernel backends.
THE PERSON
:
You are a systems-minded ML engineer who thinks in terms of throughput, latency, memory movement, and scheduling, not just model code.
You are comfortable reading and modifying large-scale inference frameworks, debugging performance across GPUs and nodes, and collaborating with kernel, compiler, and networking teams to close end-to-end performance gaps.
You enjoy working in open source and driving architecture-level improvements in inference platforms.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Inference Framework & Runtime
Architect and optimize distributed LLM inference runtimes based on in-house LLM engines or open-source stacks such as
vLLM
,
SGLang
, and
llm
-d
Design and improve TP / PP / EP (
MoE
) hybrid execution, including KV-cache management, attention dispatch, and token scheduling
Implement and optimize multi-node inference pipelines using RCCL, RDMA, and collective-based execution
Performance & Scalability
Drive throughput, latency, and memory efficiency across single-GPU and multi-GPU clusters
Optimize continuous batching, speculative decoding, KV-cache paging, prefix caching, and multi-turn serving
GPU & Backend Integration
Work with AMD GPU libraries (AITER, HIPBLAS-LT, RCCL,
ROCm
runtime) to ensure inference frameworks efficiently use FP8 / FP4 GEMM and
FlashAttention
/ MLA
Collaborate with compiler teams (Triton, LLVM,
ROCm
) to unblock framework-level performance
Open Source & Customer Enablement
Upstream features and performance fixes into
vLLM
,
SGLang
, and
llm
-d
Enable customer
PoCs
and production deployments on AMD platforms
Build and maintain benchmark-grade inference pipelines

,

, or similar inference stacks

Strong background in NVIDIA, AMD, or similar GPU architectures and kernel development

Understanding of compiler and runtime systems, including LLVM,
ROCm
, and GPU code generation

Master’s or PhD
in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or
a related field
.

Stay informed of compiler, algorithm, and architecture trends and apply them to the IR stack
Debug and fix existing issues and research alternative, more efficient ways to accomplish the same work
Develop technical relationships with peers and partners

- Support training and fine-tuning workflows for optimized models.
- Analyze and debug accuracy, latency, memory usage, and deployment tradeoffs.
- Collaborate across framework, compiler, runtime, hardware, and application teams.

AMD-92505.description:

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

THE ROLE
AMD is seeking a senior system technical leader, provide thought leadership and subject matter expertise to our growing team. As a key contributor, you will have a strong technical background to contribute to all aspects of the innovative system with partners. We have competitive benefit packages and an award-winning culture. Join us!
Based in Shenzhen, this role bridges AMD system design teams with ODM/OEM partners and component suppliers. The core focus is to surfacing external technology trends back to the internal team. A key expectation is to identify and evaluate innovation solutions for next-generation products, keeping AMD ahead on subsystem technologies.
THE PERSON
A system engineer with a solid grasp of PC/laptop subsystems — from motherboard-side controller/PHY to external components to whole-machine integration —
with strong platform-firmware depth in power, thermal, battery, and low-power architecture
. You understand the full picture well enough to have confident technical conversations with both AMD internal teams and ODM/OEM engineers. You have a strong sense of where subsystem and firmware technology is heading, and can evaluate new solutions early.
You are highly motivated, a strong communicator, and very good at collaboration.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Serve as the
primary technical bridge
between AMD internal teams and ODM/OEM partners.
Support
subsystem solution definition and component selection
(Audio, Display, Sensor, Storage, Memory), ensuring alignment between AMD architecture and ODM/OEM implementation.
Collaborate with BIOS, System, HW, and ME teams
on platform firmware — define ACPI/EC communication protocols, ensure Windows OS compatibility, and resolve sleep/wake failures, power leakage, thermal abnormalities, and intermittent issues.
Identify and evaluate innovation solutions
for next-gen products — new interfaces, component technologies, firmware architectures — and present clear recommendations to the AMD internal team.
Participate in technical design reviews on schematic, layout, BOM, firmware, and integration.
Support factory trial run and mass production — analyze yield problems and provide firmware optimization and DFX improvements.
Build and maintain good relationships with ODM/OEM teams and component suppliers.
AMD-92505.requirements:
Bachelor's degree or above in PC Computer Engineering, or related field.
8+ years
in laptop/PC system development.
Good understanding of motherboard-side solutions and external components
— Audio, Display, Sensor, Storage, Memory — and PC/laptop whole-machine integration.
Familiar with SMBus, I²C, SPI, LPC, and common peripheral communication interfaces.
Platform firmware (power / thermal / battery / low-power):
Deep understanding of notebook
power architecture, ACPI specification, and Windows power management / S-state mechanism
.
Familiar with
BIOS-EC interaction logic
and platform validation process.
Solid experience in fan-speed thermal tuning, battery fuel-gauge calibration, power-sequence debugging, and sleep/wake troubleshooting.
Independent problem-analysis capability; able to drive ODM and vendor to close technical risks efficiently.
Good verbal and written English.
PREFERRED EXPERIENCE
Hands-on EC firmware development
(AMI, Insyde, or equivalent).
Experience with major ODM/OEM laptop companies.
Experience with AMD Ryzen-based laptop platforms.

AMD-93903.title: Firmware Engineer-Multimedia Software
AMD-93903.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.
At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.
Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.
THE ROLE:
The Diagnostics team develops the software that brings up, validates, and qualifies AMD's multimedia IP across CPUs, APUs, and discrete GPUs. In this role you will design and develop diagnostics and validation tools for multimedia hardware features - including video encode/decode and post-processing - from pre-silicon through production. You will collaborate closely with hardware, firmware, driver, and validation teams, and support both internal engineering teams and external customers for chip screening, validation, and profiling. We are looking for a highly motivated engineer who enjoys low-level and embedded programming and can independently drive tasks to completion.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design and develop diagnostics software for multimedia IP feature bring-up and verification in pre-silicon (FPGA, C-Model, Palladium, etc.) and post-silicon (silicon and platform) environments
Identify and resolve IP, SoC, board, and firmware issues; provide diagnostics support to internal engineering teams and external customers for chip screening, validation, and profiling
Participate in new APU/GPU silicon bring-up and execution
Optimize diagnostics software for coverage, effectiveness, and efficiency
Develop and deploy AI-based tools and workflows to accelerate test development, failure triage, and debug
Build and debug automation tools to improve productivity
Drive improvements to the development process and innovation in multimedia diagnostics
AMD-93903.requirements:
Minimum 8 years of experience in driver, validation tool, or embedded software development, working closely with hardware designers and firmware teams
Strong mix of large-scale software development ability and hardware understanding
Proficient in C and modern C++ programming
Familiarity with Linux; device driver or firmware development experience required
Familiarity with source control systems (Git, Perforce)
Hands-on experience with SoC/board bring-up preferred
Strong debugging, testing, and communication skills
AI EXPERIENCE (REQUIRED)
Proven ability to develop and deploy AI/ML solutions that resolve real engineering problems - for example, automating test generation, hardware failure and log triage, debug assistance, or developer productivity tooling
Hands-on knowledge of Python and modern AI/ML frameworks and tooling (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, LLM APIs and agent frameworks)
Ability to integrate AI into day-to-day engineering and development workflows, with sound judgment on where AI adds value versus traditional methods
A continuous learner who actively builds and applies new AI skills as the toolset evolves
PREFERRED (MULTIMEDIA DOMAIN)
Hands-on experience with video encode/decode and/or video post-processing
Familiarity with video post-processing and enhancement algorithms, including scaling, color space conversion, gamut remap, tone mapping, alpha blending, and HDR
Familiarity with CPU/GPU/APU architecture
Experience with multi-threading or parallel programming
ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:
B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent. Good written and verbal English required.
LOCATION
Shanghai, China
#LI-VC1

AMD-92507.title: Power Solution Engineer
AMD-92507.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.
At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.
Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.
Shenzhen, China
THE ROLE
AMD is seeking a senior system power engineer, providing thought leadership and subject matter expertise to our growing team. As a key contributor, you will have a strong technical background to contribute to all aspects of the innovative system with partners. We have competitive benefit packages and an award-winning culture. Join us!
Based in Shenzhen, this role bridges AMD system design teams with ODM/OEM partners and power component suppliers. The core focus is to surface external technology trends back to the internal team. A key expectation is to identify and evaluate innovation solutions for next-generation products, keeping AMD ahead on subsystem technologies.
THE PERSON
The ideal candidate is a hands-on power engineering specialist with strong expertise in board-level power delivery and system-level platform design. A strong understanding of the power-component ecosystem. You can assess complex technical trade-offs, drive issues to closure, and turn competitive and supplier insights into practical recommendations.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Be part of the system design team serves as the primary technical bridge for internal and external.
Support subsystem solution definition and component selection, ensuring alignment between AMD architecture and ODM/OEM implementation.
Evaluate emerging power technologies, solutions, and integration approaches for next-generation AMD platforms
Build and maintain good relationships with ODM/OEM teams and component suppliers.
Participate in architecture, schematic, layout, BOM, and platform-readiness reviews, with a focus on power-delivery risks and system integration.
Investigate x86 and ARM platform power architectures, design trade-offs, and supplier strategies, and communicate actionable findings to AMD engineering and leadership teams.
Maintain strong technical knowledge of power controllers, power stages, MOSFETs, passive components, adapters, batteries, and related industry trends.
Prepare and deliver clear technical reports, design-review findings, root-cause summaries, and recommendations to both technical and business stakeholders.
AMD-92507.requirements:
Bachelor’s degree or above in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
8+ years of experience in DCDC and ACDC power design, platform engineering, system validation, or hardware debugging.
Strong knowledge of CPU/GPU platform power delivery map, including multiphase VRMs, point-of-load regulators, sequencing, telemetry, transient response, efficiency, thermal, and protections.
Experience using AMD SDLE or equivalent voltage-regulator vendor tools for configuration, telemetry, analysis, and debugging.
Good understanding of motherboard architecture, power-management firmware, BIOS interaction, low-power states, and system-level integration.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional technical investigations and drive complex issues to closure.
Strong verbal and written communication skills in both English and Mandarin.
PREFERRED EXPERIENCE
Experience with X86/ARM CPU/GPU platforms, including workstation, desktop, or server products.
Experience working directly with major PC ODM/OEM companies
Experience in competitive benchmarking and system-level power analysis across x86 and ARM platforms.
Willingness to travel as required to support AMD engineering teams, ODM/OEM partners, and component suppliers.

AMD-96918.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.
At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.
Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.
THE ROLE:
Returns Debug and RMA execution in Quality & Reliability organization, provide supportive functions to the organization to ensure customer quality issue being addressed evoking the required actions via failure analysis to improve product quality.
THE PERSON:
You will also need to possess strong verbal and written communication skills which are essential when working with a global team. A proactive, outstanding teammate who focuses on teamwork, team building, and growing team success.
AMD's environment is fast paced, results oriented and built upon a legion of forward-thinking people with a passion for winning technology!
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Perform analysis & report writing on customer returns electrical FA, include duplicate customer reported failure on Platform level and perform board level debug, analysis on Automated Test Equipment (ATE) and System Level Test (SLT).
Customer returns debug covering pre & post Mass Production, field return including Excursion/Critical issue, also cover debug for Defect Part Per Million (DPPM) improvement.
Drive cross-functional collaboration by proactively engaging with Device Analysis and Product Engineering teams to lead fault isolation and root-cause investigations.
Identify and define test coverage enhancements that strengthen product quality, prevent customer-facing failures, and support long-term reliability improvements.
Provide technical direction in diagnosing complex issues, influencing validation strategies, and ensuring findings translate into actionable quality improvements across functions.
Provide conclusive and convincing results and align with Program/PLQ/Customer Interfacing team on final analysis report writing for customer communication.
Local product ownership roles that include but not limited to understanding, tracking and releases of ATE/SLT/OSV which covers RMA/OSV program, test program contents, and Go-To person on owned product technical queries.
Role model as a coach for internal team that able to guide junior on technical challenges that arise during work for specific IP or failure category.
Other duties as assigned by supervisor.
AMD-96918.requirements:
Engineering background, capable of understanding common electrical terms and schematics on PC systems or Server platform or Graphic card
Be capable of using different instruments for HW test and debug, like oscilloscope, multimeter.
x86 architecture knowledge is much preferred
Window and Linux proficiency.
Java, Python, Perl coding or Linux Shell scripting skills
Experience working in root causes digital or analog failure or SCAN/MBIST/High Speed Loopback failure is a plus.
Candidate should be analytical and detail oriented, strongly interested in debugging complex system, self-starter, and fast learner
JTAG knowledge is a plus.
Knowledge in ATE test class/method experience with Advantest 93k platform is a plus.
Experience in AI or Machine Learning project or task is a plus.
ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering or Computer Engineering with preferred > 5 relevant years of experience

Suzhou, China

AMD-92257.title: Sensor Platform Engineer
AMD-92257.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.
At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.
Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.
THE ROLE:
This technical role is for Client Sensor Fusion Hub (SFH) solution FET (Feature Enablement Team) leader. The individual will be responsible for SFH solution enablement and successful delivery on AMD client APU products. SFH (Sensor Fusion Hub) is AMD's on-die low-power MCU sub-system  that manages and intelligently fuses data from multiple sensors — motion (accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer), environmental (ambient light, ambient color) and human presence detection — to deliver a holistic, always-on awareness of the platform and user context. The individual will primarily collaborate with cross-functional teams including SFH FW / driver, BIOS, IP, PMF/ASM, SW / Validation and OEM teams, driving the solution end-to-end through post-silicon, with pre-silicon involvement where applicable. PMF/ASM integration experience and AI (e.g. on-device AI inference, human-presence-driven experiences, Copilot+ PC AI features) experience are both a good plus.
THE PERSON:
The person needs to be self-motivated for deliveries and innovation, a quick learner with a strong sense of ownership. Strong problem-resolving mindset, cross-team driving capability and good communication skills are essential for this leadership role.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Drive post-silicon Sensor Fusion Hub (SFH) solution enablement from bring-up to product for AMD's newest client APU products. Work with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions covering sensor functionality, accuracy, power, performance and stability. Predict execution risks and provide mitigation plans. As the FET (Feature Enablement Team) leader, drive solution delivery across IP, BIOS, SFH FW, driver and OEM customer engagements.
Pre-Silicon:
SFH sensor feature list and BU functional test plan development (accelerometer, gyrometer, magnetometer, ambient light / color, human presence detect, ToF).
Review and approve IP and System validation test plans; coordinate overall platform sensor test coverage and strategy across I2C / I3C interfaces and ACPI power states.
Collaborating with emulation team for emulation task to reduce post silicon risks if applies.
Post-Silicon:
Bring-up and collaborate with cross-functional teams (HW, BIOS, SFH FW, SFH / SFI / SPB-I2C driver, diag, SW, OEM) for sensor enablement and SFH solution delivery.
End-to-end debug and drive of SFH / sensor / SFH FW / driver issues as FET leader, owning the issue from triage through closure.
Own sensor accuracy and reliability validation using robotic-arm / gyro-table / motion-simulation infrastructure, and drive ACPI stress (S0i3/S3/S4/S5/Reboot/Z-state) and HLK / certification readiness.
Customer technical support: engage OEM partners on sensor selection (AVL), calibration, integration, tuning and field issues.
Drive platform-level sensor power / responsiveness tuning; partner with PMF/ASM, PPL and P&P attainment teams to leverage sensor context in platform policy.
REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:
Knowledge of x86 client computer hardware architecture and APU sub-systems.
Strong knowledge of Windows; Linux exposure a plus.
Hands-on experience with platform Sensor solutions (e.g. accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer, ambient light / color sensor, human presence detection, time-of-flight) — sensor hub / MCU firmware, ACPI / HID integration, sensor driver stack (KMDF / UMDF, SPB-I2C, I3C).
Understanding of sensor bus / interface protocols (I2C, I3C, MIPI) and sensor calibration / fusion concepts (orientation, motion, HPD).
Experience developing and executing bring-up and feature validation test plans; strong debug skills across HW / FW / driver / OS layers.
Proven cross-team driving ability — able to align IP design, BIOS, FW, driver, validation and OEM stakeholders toward a common delivery milestone.
Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
Team leader / Project leader experience required.
AMD-92257.requirements:
Pre-silicon experience for Sensor / SFH
Hands-on experience with robotic-arm / gyro-table / motion-simulation validation infrastructure and automated sensor validation.
Forward thinker who continuously improves process and drives innovation.
Scripting and automation tool development skills.
Familiarity with PMF / ASM platform management framework and telemetry-driven dynamic tuning.
AI development or AI deployment experience — hands-on with on-device AI inference, human-presence-driven experiences, or Copilot+ PC AI features (Windows Studio Effects, adaptive dimming / Wake-on-Approach, etc.) — strongly preferred.
Hands-on experience with Image Signal Processor (ISP) / camera pipeline — sensor tuning, IQ, MIPI / CSI, camera driver and FW integration — a good plus.
Familiarity with OEM Windows platform certification / WHCK-HLK / Modern Standby tuning a plus.

degree in electrical engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science,
Engineering,
or an equivalent

AMD-92503.title: Sr. Manager Systems Design Eng.
AMD-92503.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.
At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.
Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.
Sr. Manager, System Design Engineering
Shenzhen, China
THE ROLE
AMD is seeking a Sr. Manager of System Design Engineering to lead innovative AI PC development from concept definition to solution enable/qualify with partners, and drive customer pick-and-go solutions.
Based in Shenzhen, this role will build the Client and Graphics System Engineering (CGSE) team and lab from the ground up, and lead its daily operations. You will work closely with ODM/OEM partners, component suppliers, and AMD system engineering teams to drive platform innovation, component enablement, and compatibility verification. The successful candidate will serve as the key technical bridge between AMD Shanghai System Engineering teams and Shenzhen ecosystem partners, enabling effective collaboration throughout the product development lifecycle.
THE PERSON
The ideal candidate is an experienced engineering leader with strong technical expertise in PC product development, ecosystem technologies, and product qualification before mass production. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, have an excellent sense of market technology trends, enjoy solving complex problems, and have a proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence engineering decisions across organizations. You advocate AMD's execution culture, hold the team accountable for deliverables, and can convey status and vision clearly to executives.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Build the CGSE team and lab in Shenzhen from scratch, including validation infrastructure and engineering best practices.
Serve as the key technical bridge between AMD Shanghai Engineering teams and Shenzhen partners; align with the global team on development strategy, training plan, execution culture, and priority calls.
Leverage close engagement with ODM/OEM partners and ecosystem suppliers to accelerate platform development, technology adoption, issue resolution, and parts qualification — enabling comprehensive PC components from China partners, including memory, storage, Wi-Fi, USB re-timer, EC, display, audio, sensors, and VR solutions.
Drive cross-functional technical discussions, risk assessment, root-cause analysis, and debug closure across hardware, firmware, validation, and operations teams.
Conduct design reviews covering architecture, schematic, layout, integration, and platform readiness.
Facilitate workshops and technical trainings with Shenzhen partners.
Develop and maintain positive relationships with key Shenzhen stakeholders (HR, IT, facility) to ensure effective team operation.
Mentor engineers, develop technical leaders, and foster a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, and innovation.
AMD-92503.requirements:
Bachelor's degree or above in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field. Master's preferred.
15+ years of experience in PC/notebook hardware design and development, with 10+ years in management.
Proven track record of leading cross-functional engineering teams and delivering products from concept through volume production.
Strong technical breadth and depth, with expertise in memory sub-system validation, system-level validation, motherboard design, or low-power system design.
Strong understanding of PC/notebook system architecture, motherboard design, power delivery, SI/PI, EMC, thermal/mechanical, and RF.
Deep technical understanding of key laptop components, including display panels, cameras, audio, wireless modules, batteries, storage devices, sensors, and peripheral interfaces.
Experience with platform bring-up, debugging, validation, and ODM/OEM collaboration.
Experience working across geographically distributed engineering teams.
Strong verbal and written communication skills in both English and Chinese.
PREFERRED EXPERIENCE
Leadership working experience in top-tier PC companies.
Established relationships with component suppliers and a track record of influencing supplier technology roadmaps.
Experience in engineering management or leading technical project teams of significant scale.
Out-of-the-box thinking; ability to leverage AI to improve team productivity and problem-solving.

THE ROLE:
We are looking for a dynamic, energetic Systems Test Validation Engineer to join our growing team. This technical role is AMD client Post-Silicon features IO validation and enablement at the silicon IP level up through IP, integration, and system levels on AMD client products. This individual will be primarily responsible for leading the USB, Misc IO validation, interfacing with IP design, debug, BIOS/firmware, and platform design groups to develop, optimize and execute validation test plans for client products from pre-silicon validation plan to post-silicon bring-up/validation, debug feature issues, and maintain validation infrastructure to achieve product deliver milestones.
THE PERSON:
As an IO functional Validation Engineer, the candidate should be self‑motivated, delivery‑driven, and innovation‑minded, with a strong technical foundation in IO IP (SoC/IP blocks) and clear, effective communication skills. Preference for candidates with AI tool development and deployment experience to improve validation efficiency
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Perform USB and Misc low speed IOfunctional validation at system level and IP/block level in pre-silicon and/or post-silicon environments.
Develop validation plans, test cases, and test environments based on design specifications and architecture documents.
Execute validation tests, analyze results, and ensure comprehensive coverage for USB IP and related system components.
Validate and debug features and interoperability involving IO subsystems on x86-based platforms.
Work closely with design, architecture, firmware, and software teams to identify root-cause, and resolve functional issues.
Participate in automation and improvement of validation flows, AI tools, and methodologies.
Execute and drive success of programs with multiple projects on the goal
AMD-93567.requirements:
Solid understanding of x86 architecture, including system-level components and interactions & Strong knowledge of USB & low Speed IO Spec and protocol (e.g., USB 2.0/3.x/USB4. TBT)
Experience with debug and issue root-cause, including use of common debug tools (Windows ETL, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, waveform viewers, etc.).
Familiarity with Linux operating system, including basic shell usage, scripting, and driver/application bring-up.
Experience with pre-silicon verification/validation environments (e.g., simulation, emulation, FPGA prototyping) or post-silicon validation labs.
Knowledge of system-level performance, power, and reliability validation concepts for I/O subsystems.
Familiarity with AI applications, or hands-on experience in developing AI-driven tools/workflows for validation or related domains.

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in related discipline preferred

AMD-94265.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.
At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.
Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.
THE ROLE:
AMD is looking for a lead systems engineer to provide thought leadership and subject matter expertise to our growing team. As a key contributor, you will have a strong technical background to contribute to all aspects of the post-silicon development process. We have competitive benefit packages and an award-winning culture. Join us!
The AMD S3 Business Unit IP Systems Engineering team is seeking an energetic, dynamic, experienced IP Systems Engineer to join our growing team. We work with customers to develop new products, previously including game consoles.  As an IP Systems Engineer, you will drive the planning, pre-silicon execution, validation, silicon bring-up and debug of AMD processor and graphics based systems while working closely with internal teams to meet product development milestones.
As a key contributor to the success of AMD's IP, you will be part of a leading team that drives and enhances AMD's abilities to deliver industry leading technologies to our customers. The Systems Engineering team encourages technical innovation to showcase successes, provides opportunities to develop technical knowledge, and facilitates career development. This role also requires a broad knowledge of the system design lifecycle, spanning across pre-silicon into post-silicon validation. There is a focus on comprehensive validation documentation and execution.
This core domains for this role include the IO and system hub, IP interconnect systems and shared memory functions of semi-custom SoCs. IP integration, data fabric, system control, hardware virtualization and cross-IP functions are all relevant.
THE PERSON:
You are a highly motivated hands-on leader with a strong development background, problem solving mentality, excellent communication skills. Ability to prioritize tasks along with willingness to learn and adapt. Excellent teamwork skills and capability to lead a highly technical team is crucial. Able to work across geographies and team boundaries to get results.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Participate in systems design development throughout entire product lifecycle, from pre-silicon and emulation through post-silicon and software integration.
Lead technical presentations demonstrating a good understanding of hardware architecture and expertise in systems design
Collaborate with Design, Software, Tools and other teams to drive the definition of testing and debug methodologies to provide the best possible coverage and customer experience for the AMD IP
Isolation and debug of issues found during pre-silicon, bring-up, validation, and production phases of S3 products
Able to proactively support team culture that fosters knowledge sharing, excellence, and collaboration
Defining and executing validation strategies, enablement of features and unit test plans
Publishing and aligning test plan requirements and dependencies
Working closely with supporting teams such as design, diagnostics, driver, and project leadership
Lead cross-functional technical discussions to drive root cause identification and resolution on technical issues
Driving and participating in technical innovations to enhance AMD’s validation capabilities including tool and script developments, technical and methodology enhancements
AMD-94265.requirements:
In-depth knowledge of SOC architecture and concepts
Experience with IP/System level bring-up
Knowledge of Virtualization
Experience with FPGA and other hardware emulation platforms for pre-silicon debug
Strong understanding of BIOS, OS, and driver-level interactions and common failure points
Good understanding of Boot Flows/Sequences
Experience with common lab equipment, computer hardware, and networks
Led process improvement initiatives to improve engineering quality
Strong technical leadership and mentoring skills
Knowledge of standard power management features and use-cases
PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:
Minimum 5 years of experience in pre and post-silicon validation
Demonstrated ability to grasp new technical concepts quickly
Strong programming/scripting skills (e.g. Python, C/C++,  Ruby)
Experience with IP/System level bring-up, SOC debug techniques and methodologies
Strong analytical/problem solving skills and pronounced attention to details
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Self-starter, strong collaborator, and able to independently drive tasks to completion
Strong organizational skills and ability to handle multiple issues at the same time
ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS
:
Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or related field strongly preferred

:
Shanghai

AMD is seeking a senior system technical leader,

expertise to our growing team. As a key contributor, you will have
a strong
technical background to contribute
to
all aspects of the innovative system with partners
.
We have competitive benefit packages and an award-winning culture. Join us!
Based in Shenzhen, this role bridges AMD system design teams with ODM/OEM partners and component suppliers. The core focus is to surfacing external technology trends back to the internal team. A key expectation is to identify and evaluate innovation solutions for next-generation products, keeping AMD ahead on subsystem technologies.
THE PERSON
A System engineer with a solid grasp of PC/laptop subsystems — from motherboard-side controller/PHY to external components to whole-machine integration. You understand the full picture well enough to have confident technical conversations with both AMD internal teams and ODM/OEM engineers. You have a strong sense of where subsystem technology is heading and can evaluate new solutions early, before they become the industry standard.
You are highly motivated, a strong communicator and very good at collabration.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Be part of the System desing team, serve as the primary technical bridge for internal and external.
Support subsystem solution definition and component selection, ensuring alignment between AMD architecture and ODM/OEM implementation.
Identify and evaluate innovation solutions for next-generation products
— new interfaces, new component technologies, new integration approaches — and present clear recommendations to the AMD internal team.
Participate in technical design reviews on schematic, layout, BOM, and integration.
Build and maintain good relationships with ODM/OEM teams and component suppliers.

Good verbal and written English

AMD-92242.title: Test Engineer
AMD-92242.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.
At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.
Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.
THE ROLE:
The Board and System Test Engineering group is responsible for activities of the full product life cycle. Activities include pre-silicon phase such as driving design for test and manufacturability, test plans, etc.; new product introduction (NPI) phase such as development of automated test equipment (ATE) test solutions, verification, and validation of product performance; production phase such as driving down costs through test time reduction and yield improvement and high customer quality.
Job responsibilities for this position include board/system test leadership at the factory, debug of test interface HW, develop test plans, board issue debug, data analysis for device performance, HW/SW & system integration, characterization test, releasing cost effective production test solutions into mass production, test support in production, yield improvement and test time reduction activities.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
You will work closely with multi-functional teams, circuit and logic design, verification, test engineering to accomplish tasks.
You will work closely with our vendors.
You will lead a cross-function Engineering team to help guide Client motherboard products from NPI to mass production. Along the way, you will help to identify and solve a wide range of issues that are blocking the volume ramp.
You will initiate debug activities onsite at the factory and with your peers at AMD.
Applicants should be experienced in HW troubleshooting with excellent communication and leadership skills.
Ability to work with common bench top test equipment (oscilloscope, spectrum analyzer, logic analyzer, power supplies, etc).
Able to work independently and with good initiative/leadership to overcome technical challenges.
Coordinate/lead closely with peers & seniors to ensure timely and effective communication of all assigned work activities.
A self-starter is required and able to deal with a high-level of ambiguity.
Support server manufacturing bring-up/testing/training at the factory.

You should have at least 2+ years of relevant experience in test manufacturing support.

Solid experience in supporting test in manufacturing.
Deep understanding of PC and server architecture.
Hardware Expertise with strong debugging and analytical skills.
Deep knowledge of electronic circuit debugging and analytical skills.
Solid experience of Linux Environment.

Knowledge and hands on experience of setting up workloads in a hyper converged infrastructure highly desired.

AMD-93065.title: Hardware/System QA & Failure Analysis Engineer
AMD-93065.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.
At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.
Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.
Hardware/System QA & Failure Analysis Engineer
Job Summary
We are seeking a hands-on Hardware/System QA & Failure Analysis Engineer to support the validation, testing, and failure analysis of AI NIC, switch, and networking platforms.
In this role, you will focus on investigating hardware and system failures from engineering validation, manufacturing, and field returns, identifying root causes, and driving issue resolution. You will also develop automated test solutions, perform system-level validation, and improve diagnostic and regression test coverage to enhance product quality and reliability.
The ideal candidate has experience in networking or embedded systems, strong Linux and Python skills, and a solid background in hardware diagnostics, system testing, troubleshooting, and test automation.
Responsibilities
Perform failure analysis on AI NIC, switch, and networking hardware from engineering validation, manufacturing, and field returns.
Investigate and reproduce hardware and system failures, analyze diagnostic logs and test results, and isolate issues across hardware, firmware, and software.
Debug board-level and system-level failures, including boot issues, Ethernet/PCIe connectivity, interface bring-up, power, thermal, and stability problems.
Work with hardware, firmware, software, and manufacturing teams to identify root causes, implement corrective actions, and validate fixes.
Analyze manufacturing test data and failure trends to identify recurring issues, improve test coverage, and reduce failure rates.
Develop and maintain Python-based diagnostic and automated test scripts to support failure reproduction, debugging, regression testing, and validation.
Develop and execute hardware and system-level test plans, test cases, and validation procedures.
Perform functional, integration, regression, stress, power-cycle, and stability testing.
Build and maintain hardware test environments and test setups for validation, debugging, and failure analysis.
Support platform bring-up, manufacturing test readiness, and continuous improvement of product quality and reliability.
AMD-93065.requirements:
BS/MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
Experience in hardware/system validation, testing, debugging, or failure analysis of networking, server, or embedded platforms.
Hands-on experience with Ethernet switches, routers, NICs, or other networking hardware.
Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with experience reproducing failures, analyzing diagnostic logs, and isolating hardware or software issues.
Experience with board-level and system-level hardware diagnostics, boot validation, interface bring-up, and stability testing.
Strong Python programming and Linux experience for test automation, diagnostics, and debugging.
Experience developing test plans, test cases, and automated regression tests.
Good understanding of Ethernet networking, PHY, optics, and common hardware interfaces.
Experience with hardware debugging tools, test equipment, and network traffic generators is a plus.
Familiarity with PCIe, high-speed SerDes, PRBS, BER, loopback, and high-speed link validation is a plus.
Experience with manufacturing failure analysis, field returns, root-cause analysis, or corrective action processes is a plus.
Experience with AI NICs, SmartNICs, switch SDKs, or manufacturing test environments is a plus.

AMD-97265.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.
At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.
Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.
THE ROLE:
Work with global Front-End design team and physical design team for large scale ASIC chip physical implementation. Focus on physical design of deep sub-micron GPU chips including block level floor planning, place&route, physical verification etc.
THE PERSON:

AMD-94229.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.
At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

THE ROLE:
As a member of the Fullchip Floorplan CAD team, you will help develop and enable advanced full-chip physical design methodologies for cutting-edge SoC designs. You will focus on
Fullchip Floorplan flow development
, working closely with project teams to deliver robust and scalable solutions for complex full-chip designs.
As a senior technical contributor, you will
own key methodologies from concept through production deployment
, drive technical direction, resolve complex design and flow challenges, and provide technical leadership across multiple engineering teams.
THE PERSON:
The successful candidate will be a highly motivated and experienced silicon design engineer with a strong background in physical design and CAD methodology development. The candidate should be able to independently drive complex technical problems, define solutions, and collaborate effectively across organizational and geographical boundaries.
The candidate will demonstrate
strong technical leadership, ownership, communication, and problem-solving skills
, with the ability to mentor engineers, influence technical decisions, and drive methodology improvements from initial development through successful production adoption.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Own and drive major functions' methodology and flow development
for large-scale SoC designs.
Develop methodologies to identify and optimize repeater and feedthrough requirements based on floorplan, connectivity, timing, hierarchy, and physical constraints.
Drive complex technical issues to resolution across timing, long-distance interconnect, hierarchy, placement, congestion, and routability.
Develop robust and scalable CAD automation using
Tcl, Python, Perl.
Drive methodology and flow improvements from
concept, prototyping and validation through production deployment
.
Work across Physical Design, Front-End Design/Integration, Timing teams to align requirements and ensure successful methodology integration.
Provide
technical leadership and guidance
, conduct technical reviews, and mentor junior engineers.
Proactively identify methodology gaps, propose solutions, and drive continuous improvements in
quality, scalability, runtime, robustness, and usability
.
Support production projects, analyze complex flow issues, drive root-cause analysis, and develop systematic solutions to prevent recurrence.
Communicate technical strategy, implementation status, risks, and recommendations clearly to engineering stakeholders and leadership.
AMD-94229.requirements:
Strong understanding of ASIC physical design fundamentals, including
floorplanning, placement, routing, timing analysis, hierarchical design, and timing closure
.
Experience with
full-chip physical design
, particularly long-distance interconnect optimization, repeater/buffer insertion, feedthrough planning, or related methodologies.
Experience with physical design tools such as
Cadence Innovus and/or Synopsys Fusion Compiler/ICC2
.
Strong programming and scripting skills in
Tcl, Python, Perl
.
Demonstrated experience developing and deploying
CAD/EDA methodologies and automation
for large-scale SoC designs.
Proven ability to independently drive complex methodology development from
problem definition and solution architecture through implementation, validation, and production deployment
.
Experience providing
technical leadership, mentoring engineers, and driving cross-functional technical decisions
.
Excellent debugging and analytical skills with the ability to identify root causes and develop scalable solutions rather than testcase-specific fixes.
Strong communication skills and demonstrated ability to collaborate with multiple engineering teams.
ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:
Bachelor's or Master's degree in
Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
.

AMD-92187.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.
At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.
Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.
AUTOMOTIVE REGIONAL SYSTEM ARCHITECT - GREATER CHINA
THE ROLE:
The Automotive Regional System Architect - Greater China will help shape AMD's automotive technology strategy and customer engagement across the region. Reporting to the Automotive Solutions Director, this role will also work closely with the Automotive Business Segment Senior Director and collaborate across sales, automotive marketing, and global engineering teams.
You will apply AMD's world-class CPU, GPU, AI, and programmable logic technologies to next-generation automotive solutions, with a focus on Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) and automated driving, infotainment, and driver information systems. This is a highly visible, customer-facing role that combines system architecture, market insight, solution development, ecosystem engagement, and technical influence to support the long-term growth of AMD's automotive business in Greater China.
THE PERSON:
The successful candidate is a strategic and hands-on system architect who can connect customer needs, market trends, and complex technologies to create compelling automotive solutions. You communicate clearly with both technical and business stakeholders, build trusted customer relationships, and collaborate effectively across regional and global teams. You are comfortable working in a fast-moving environment, navigating ambiguity, and translating insights into practical architecture proposals and demonstrable solutions.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Develop targeted automotive system solutions for the Greater China market using AMD CPU, GPU, AI, and programmable logic technologies.
• Lead system-level architecture analysis and develop customer- and project-specific technical proposals for ADAS and automated driving, infotainment, and driver information applications.
• Gather, analyze, and communicate local market, customer, technology, and competitive trends to relevant AMD stakeholders.
• Create, maintain, and enhance vehicle-based demonstration platforms that showcase AMD automotive capabilities and customer value.
• Engage with key automotive customers to understand system requirements, influence architecture decisions, and identify new business opportunities.
• Build productive relationships with strategic automotive ecosystem partners and support joint solution development and enablement activities.
• Partner closely with AMD sales, automotive marketing, and engineering teams to define differentiated value propositions and support customer engagements.
• Develop trusted relationships that encourage transparency, strengthen technical collaboration, and support the long-term growth of AMD's automotive business.
• Represent regional customer and market requirements within AMD and help align local opportunities with global product and solution roadmaps.
AMD-92187.requirements:
• Strong system architecture or solution architecture experience in the automotive semiconductor, automotive electronics, or embedded systems industry.
• Knowledge of automotive compute platforms and applications, particularly ADAS and automated driving, infotainment, digital cockpit, or driver information systems.
• Technical understanding of one or more of the following: CPU architectures, GPU computing, AI acceleration, programmable logic, embedded software, or heterogeneous computing.
• Experience translating customer requirements into system architectures, technical proposals, proof-of-concept platforms, or demonstrations.
• Experience working directly with automotive OEMs, Tier 1 suppliers, technology partners, or semiconductor ecosystem companies in Greater China.
• Ability to analyze market and competitive information and communicate actionable insights to regional and global stakeholders.
• Strong presentation, influencing, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across technical and business audiences.
• Fluency in Mandarin and strong professional English communication skills are preferred.
• Willingness to travel within Greater China and internationally as business needs require.
ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Automotive Engineering, or a related technical field is preferred.

This is a highly visible, customer-facing role that combines system architecture, market insight, solution development, ecosystem engagement, and technical influence to support the long-term growth of AMD's automotive business in Greater China.
THE PERSON:
The successful candidate is a strategic and hands-on system architect who can connect customer needs, market trends, and complex technologies to create compelling automotive solutions. You communicate clearly with both technical and business stakeholders, build trusted customer relationships, and collaborate effectively across regional and global teams. You are comfortable working in a fast-moving environment, navigating ambiguity, and translating insights into practical architecture proposals and demonstrable solutions.

• Create, maintain, and enhance vehicle-based demonstration platforms that showcase AMD automotive capabilities and customer value.

• Build productive relationships with strategic automotive ecosystem partners and support joint solution development and enablement activities.
• Partner closely with AMD sales, automotive marketing, and engineering teams to define differentiated value propositions and support customer engagements.
• Develop trusted relationships that encourage transparency, strengthen technical collaboration, and support the long-term growth of AMD's automotive business.
• Represent regional customer and market requirements within AMD and help align local opportunities with global product and solution roadmaps.

• Strong system architecture or solution architecture experience in the automotive semiconductor, automotive electronics, or embedded systems industry.
• Knowledge of automotive compute platforms and applications, particularly ADAS and automated driving, infotainment, digital cockpit, or driver information systems.
• Technical understanding of one or more of the following: CPU architectures, GPU computing, AI acceleration, programmable logic, embedded software, or heterogeneous computing.
• Experience translating customer requirements into system architectures, technical proposals, proof-of-concept platforms, or demonstrations.
• Experience working directly with automotive OEMs, Tier 1 suppliers, technology partners, or semiconductor ecosystem companies in Greater China.
• Ability to analyze market and competitive information and communicate actionable insights to regional and global stakeholders.
• Strong presentation, influencing, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across technical and business audiences.
• Fluency in Mandarin and strong professional English communication skills are preferred.
• Willingness to travel within Greater China and internationally as business needs require.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Automotive Engineering, or a related technical field is preferred.

AMD-93246.title: Technical Program Manager
AMD-93246.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.
At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.
Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.
THE ROLE:
The Technical Program Manager is an integral support resource for the CGVDI & Radeon AI Customer Engineering team.  The Technical Program Manager is primarily responsible for the overall management and execution of the assigned enterprise customer programs which include planning, driving, and reporting on customer program milestones.
THE PERSON:
Manage, lead and own customer program requirements and execution from concept to mass production.
Manage customer programs and schedules, customer issues (business related, hardware related, software related, etc.) throughout the life of the program.
Provide an effective communication interface with the customer and ensure customer message is aligned with AMD business and product strategy.
Report weekly customer program status to executives and internal AMD stakeholders.
Manage internal efforts to ensure that overall customer satisfaction is maintained and improved as necessary.
Support the account team, business managers, sales and field application engineers to win new business.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Manage, lead, and fully own the customer program. Ensure that customer requirements are identified early enough to allow alignment with internal development programs.
Lead an effective customer program team with internal groups within Sales, Business Manager, Product Manager, Applications Engineer, Field Applications Engineer, Board Program Manager, Software Program Manager as required.
Work with the customer to identify and define requirements, documents, and communicate with the internal teams. Ensure that the program team fully understands the customer's needs and priorities to allow effective planning and prioritization with the appropriate AMD core team.
Work with functional teams to clarify the scope of requirements from the customer CRDs (customer requirement documents) and ensure customer needs are included in AMD NPI product plans and are delivered according to customer’s expectations (schedule, functionality, etc.). Document AMD negotiated deliverables for customer specified projects, including H/W and S/W scope, program schedules, quality programs, project plans, etc.
Work with AMD leadership to ensure that technical resources are assigned to all technical issues. Provide cross-functional partnerships among technical groups, so that schedules and customer expectations are met. Communicate and negotiate with the customer regarding support expectations and schedules for key deliverables.
Define, track, and ensure timeliness of major program deliverables. Maintain an overall program schedule to highlight the major and critical milestones and risks of customer program.
Monitor and report progress to executive team on product development efforts from inception to production. Ensure major account deliverables are rolled into respective product programs and present customer issues, and underlying risks at program review meetings.
Participate in the coordination of AMD product changes (ECNs, BOM, Security updates) with the customer, product program management, engineering, and any other related groups until the change is fully implemented.
Manage customer program meetings and customer conference calls. Document and distribute meeting action items and action items from these meetings/calls.  Work with peer support teams to ensure that minutes/action items are properly documented and distributed.
Provide input to product management to ensure smooth implementation of product lifecycle, end-of-life, input to product features, and roadmap.
Drive and facilitate corrective actions and lessons learned to improve product and internal AMD processes.
Partner with other AMD groups to enhance and maintain customer relationships and participate as an integral member of the account team in the pre-sales activities.
Participate in additional program management activities as agreed with extended support teams such as RFI/RFQ coordination, customer survey, and customer evaluation.
AMD-93246.requirements:
8+ years’ experience in a similar technical program management role or similar customer support role.
Familiar with Enterprise Operating systems, device drivers, ROCm, firmware, and BIOS.
Familiar with virtualization software (Citrix, VMWare, etc) and Compute (e.g. OpenCL)
Experience with GPUs and Server architecture with competencies on both hardware and software
Familiar with AI and Machine Learning workloads
Must possess excellent problem solving and analytical skills.
Strong written, verbal communication skills, and negotiating skills.
Good knowledge of program management methodologies
Ability to work well with internal and external engineering experts (and non-experts) to develop practical solutions to challenging problems.
Must be very detail-oriented, organized, and capable of multi-tasking in a fast-moving environment.
Motivated to provide highly responsive support as needed. Must be a self-starter who is able to work independently with little supervision.
ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:
Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering, Computer Science or Electrical Engineering
Formal Project Management education, PMP certified
